claims.text: Executive Director of the Board of the Sol Foundation, which he co-founded with Peter Skafish.

Sol Foundation leadership: Garry Nolan (Executive Director of the Board), Peter Skafish (Executive Director), Jennifer Preston (COO), Matt Mason (CMO), Christian Peters (Associate Director of Research), Kirk McConnell (Senior Legislative Affairs Officer), Aneil Mallavarapu (independent board member).

b.label: AARO / Oak Ridge National Laboratory materials analyses

edges.label: competing materials programme
edges.note: The Sol Foundation's April 2026 peer-reviewed atomic and isotopic analysis of possible UAP material is the private-sector counterpart to AARO's two ORNL specimen studies, both of which resolved to terrestrial manufacture.

edges.label: Co-founder and Executive Director of the Board
edges.note: Co-founded with Peter Skafish on 15 August 2023; the foundation's materials-research programme is built around the analytical capability Nolan brought.

edges.label: delivers the monthly Sol Briefing; authors Sol policy briefings
edges.note: The Sol Foundation identifies von Rennenkampff as a Sol Foundation Fellow and carries his paper 'The Civilizational Risks of a UAP Technology Arms Race: Nonhuman Technology and Global Security', which argues for international cooperation on UAP technology development. Garry Nolan is listed as Executive Director of the Board. Tier 2: the foundation's public pages read here do not carry the Science and Policy Briefings series, so his role in it is not asserted from this source.

edges.label: Co-founder, Executive Director and Secretary of the Board
edges.note: Skafish is the institutional architect of the foundation's science-plus-policy-plus-education structure and author of its November 2024 paper on executive-branch secrecy and harm to Congress.

edges.label: Sol leadership named to the ODNI/FBI council, 22 June 2026
edges.note: Nolan, Skafish, senior adviser Tim Gallaudet, advisory board member Jacob Haqq-Misra and production lead Ross Howard were all named; the foundation called it 'a fulfillment of its founding mission'.
